newsAll.head: Saquon Barkley: Solid numbers in double-digit loss
newsAll.body: Barkley rushed 15 times for 82 yards and secured one of two targets for minus-2 yards in the Eagles' 27-7 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

newsAll.head: D'Andre Swift: Strong finish in Week 3 win
newsAll.body: Swift rushed 20 times for 84 yards and brought in two of three targets for four yards in the Bears' 27-7 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

newsAll.head: Jalen Hurts: Evaluated for concussion, cleared to return
newsAll.body: Hurts exited Monday's game versus Chicago to be evaluated for a concussion and has since been cleared to return.

newsAll.head: Michael Pittman: Limited to two catches in return
newsAll.body: Pittman caught two passes on five targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Bengals.

newsAll.head: Denzel Boston: Records two catches in Week 3 win
newsAll.body: Boston caught two passes on four passes for 41 yards during the Browns' 21-18 win over the Panthers on Sunday. He also caught a two-point conversion.
